def decide(bars, account):
    """Long-only slow trend follower. Enter when price is above a rising long-term
    average (200-day if available, else 100-day). Exit only on a close more than 5%
    below that long-term average, so we stay invested through normal pullbacks."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    n = len(closes)
    if n < 106:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history"
    price = closes[-1]
    if n >= 206:
        win = 200
    else:
        win = 100
    ma = sum(closes[-win:]) / win
    ma_prev = sum(closes[-win - 5:-5]) / win
    if account["position"] <= 0:
        if price > ma and ma > ma_prev:
            return "BUY", "price above rising %d-day" % win
        return "HOLD", "no confirmed long-term uptrend"
    if price < ma * 0.95:
        return "SELL", "close >5% below %d-day" % win
    return "HOLD", "long-term uptrend intact"

def decide(bars, account):
    """Long-only trend follower. Enter when price is above a rising 50-day average,
    OR when price reclaims the 50-day from below while the 50-day is not falling
    sharply (within 0.5% of its prior level). Exit on a close more than 1.5% below
    the 50-day."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    n = len(closes)
    if n < 56:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history"
    price = closes[-1]
    prev = closes[-2]
    ma50 = sum(closes[-50:]) / 50
    ma50_prev = sum(closes[-55:-5]) / 50
    ma50_yday = sum(closes[-51:-1]) / 50
    if account["position"] <= 0:
        if price > ma50 and ma50 > ma50_prev:
            return "BUY", "price above rising 50-day"
        # reclaim: crossed above the 50-day this bar, and 50-day not falling sharply
        if prev <= ma50_yday and price > ma50 and ma50 >= ma50_prev * 0.995:
            return "BUY", "reclaim of 50-day"
        return "HOLD", "no confirmed uptrend"
    if price < ma50 * 0.985:
        return "SELL", "close >1.5% below 50-day"
    return "HOLD", "uptrend intact"

def decide(bars, account):
    """Long-only trend follower: enter when price is above a rising 50-day average,
    or above both the 20-day and 50-day after a recovery; exit only on a close
    more than 1.5% below the 50-day to ignore one-day noise breaks."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    n = len(closes)
    if n < 56:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history"

    ma50_prev = sum(closes[-55:-5]) / 50
    ma20 = sum(closes[-20:]) / 20

        return "HOLD", "no confirmed uptrend"
    if price < ma50 * 0.985:
        return "SELL", "close >1.5% below 50-day"
    return "HOLD", "uptrend intact"

def decide(bars, account):
    """Long-only trend follower: stay invested while the 20/50 regime is bullish,
    exit only on a confirmed break (price below 50-day by 3% and 20 below 50)."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    n = len(closes)
    if n < 55:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history"
    price = closes[-1]
    ma20 = sum(closes[-20:]) / 20
    ma50 = sum(closes[-50:]) / 50
    ma50_prev = sum(closes[-55:-5]) / 50
    ma50_slope = (ma50 - ma50_prev) / ma50_prev
    bullish_regime = (ma20 > ma50) or (price > ma20)
    if account["position"] <= 0:
        if bullish_regime and ma50_slope > -0.03:
            return "BUY", "bullish 20/50 regime, trend not collapsing"
        return "HOLD", "no entry signal"
    if price < ma50 * 0.97 and ma20 < ma50:
        return "SELL", "confirmed break below 50-day with 20 under 50"
    return "HOLD", "uptrend intact"

def decide(bars, account):
    """Long-only trend follower: enter when price reclaims the 50-day average
    and the 50-day is not in a steep decline; exit on a clear break below it."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    n = len(closes)
    if n < 55:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history"
    price = closes[-1]
    ma50 = sum(closes[-50:]) / 50
    ma50_prev = sum(closes[-55:-5]) / 50
    ma50_slope = (ma50 - ma50_prev) / ma50_prev
    if account["position"] <= 0:
        if price > ma50 and ma50_slope > -0.02:
            return "BUY", "close above 50-day average, trend not collapsing"
        return "HOLD", "no entry signal"
    if price < ma50 * 0.98:
        return "SELL", "close broke below 50-day average"
    return "HOLD", "uptrend intact"

def decide(bars, account):
    """Hold while the stock is in an uptrend: close above the 50-day average and
    the 20-day average above the 50-day average. Exit on a clear trend break."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    n = len(closes)
    if n < 50:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for a 50-day average"
    price = closes[-1]
    ma50 = sum(closes[-50:]) / 50
    ma20 = sum(closes[-20:]) / 20
    if account["position"] <= 0:
        if price > ma50 and ma20 > ma50:
            return "BUY", "close above 50-day average and 20-day above 50-day"
        return "HOLD", "no entry signal"
    # exit only on a clear break below the 50-day average (2% buffer)
    if price < ma50 * 0.98:
        return "SELL", "close broke below 50-day average"
    return "HOLD", "uptrend intact"

def decide(bars, account):
    """Seed strategy: hold the stock while its close is above the 20-day average."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 20:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for a 20-day average"
    average = sum(closes[-20:]) / 20
    price = closes[-1]
    if account["position"] <= 0 and price > average:
        return "BUY", "close is above the 20-day average"
    if account["position"] > 0 and price < average:
        return "SELL", "close is below the 20-day average"
    return "HOLD", "no change"
